_label: SYNTHETIC reference demo. Not customer evidence.
trigger: aggregate commitments to the same vendor within a rolling 24-hour window exceed 50,000 USD, including the requested order
requirements: approval vendor matches the request vendor
approval currency matches the request currency
approval amount cap is at or above the aggregate commitment
approval was issued before the request
approval has not expired at the time of the request
approval has not been used for a prior order

evidence_citations.claim: PO-88219 for 78,000 USD was created without an approval record
the order was cancelled two days later with a 2,100 USD fee

assumptions: 50,000 USD is the customer's existing director-approval threshold (stated by the business owner, not present in evidence)
24 hours is the aggregation window the business owner chose; the evidence does not fix a window
non-USD orders are out of scope until a conversion record exists
missing_evidence: the agent's prompt or policy text at version 2026.08.1

approval.approver: SYNTHETIC: J. Ellis, Director of Procurement Operations
approval.rationale: Single-order threshold was the original policy. Split orders were not considered until the loophole check. Aggregating by vendor over 24 hours matches how the team already thinks about vendor exposure.
edited_fields: trigger: changed from single-order amount to rolling vendor aggregate
